allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Name, Length, Mode | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "---PREVIA SIZE---"; \(Get-Item previa-cmdca-pinda.html\).Length; Write-Output "---LINE COUNT---"; \(Get-Content previa-cmdca-pinda.html | Measure-Object -Line\).Lines)

PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'node','npm','pnpm','corepack','git','gh'\) { $cmd = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { try { $v = \(& $c --version 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1\) } catch { $v = '\(falhou\)' }; "{0,-9}: {1}" -f $c, $v } else { "{0,-9}: NAO ENCONTRADO" -f $c } })
